item.title: Rallying Cry – September 25, 2026
item.description: Hundreds of thousands are gathering in Paris for the Pope's historic visit, while scientists just discovered a clever way to reveal hidden writing in ancient scrolls by burning them, and the U.S. is stepping up with $267 million to fight Ebola.
